title: Sci-Fi
story: Lights down, the big screen glows, and the farm heads off to the stars.

cards.name: Flying Saucer
cards.subject: A round silver flying saucer, perfectly symmetrical, with a smooth clear dome on top, a flat disc rim with a ring of eight yellow lights and three small round feet underneath, flying in a clear sky.
cards.hero_colors: silver, grey, pale green dome, small yellow lights

cards.name: Ringed Planet
cards.subject: A round orange planet with soft cream stripes and one wide flat ring circling its middle at a tilt, the ring symmetrical with a thin pink stripe on it.
cards.hero_colors: orange, cream, small pink stripe on the ring

cards.name: Satellite
cards.subject: A gold box-shaped satellite body with two rectangular blue solar panels fixed on opposite sides by short arms and a small white round dish on top.
cards.hero_colors: gold, white, blue solar panels

cards.name: Space Helmet
cards.subject: A round white space helmet with a wide curved gold visor and a thick ring collar at the neck, with an orange stripe on the collar and two small hose connectors on its sides.
cards.hero_colors: white, gold visor, small orange stripe on the collar

cards.name: Glow Flask
cards.subject: A conical glass flask with a round body and narrow neck, a tan cork stopper and bright green glowing liquid with three yellow bubbles.
cards.hero_colors: green liquid, clear glass, tan cork, small yellow bubbles

cards.name: Moon Rover
cards.subject: A white six-wheeled rover with a flat boxy body, a small round dish on a short mast fixed on top and a front camera box with a blue lens, standing on grey dust.
cards.hero_colors: white, grey, black wheels, small blue lens

cards.name: Star Map
cards.subject: A round dark blue star chart lying flat, with white dots joined by thin lines and one small orange ringed planet icon.
cards.hero_colors: navy blue, white, small orange planet icon

cards.name: Rocket
cards.subject: A tall white rocket with a pointed red nose cone, two round yellow windows and four red fins at its base, standing upright on a flat concrete launch pad.
cards.hero_colors: white, red, small yellow windows

cards.name: Control Panel
cards.subject: A grey rectangular control panel mounted on a wall, with a blue screen showing a planet icon, three rows of round yellow buttons and two sliding levers fixed in slots.
cards.hero_colors: grey, blue screen, small yellow buttons

cards.name: Space Farm
cards.subject: The cow and the rooster wear matching silver space jumpsuits and stand in a grassy field while a small flying saucer hovers above them with a pale light, and the rooster points up with its wing.
cards.hero_colors: white, black, orange, silver
cards.surface_or_setting: a grassy field under a clear sky

cards.name: Copper Saucer
cards.subject: A round copper flying saucer, symmetrical, with a smooth green glass dome on top, a flat disc rim with six round yellow windows and a small round beacon under the middle, flying in a clear sky.
cards.hero_colors: copper, green dome, small yellow windows

cards.name: Retro Rocket
cards.subject: A retro red rocket flying upward with a rounded nose, three cream fins and one round green porthole, with a bright fire with a yellow-white glowing core, orange flame tips curling downward under the engine, and warm orange light cast on the rocket's base.
cards.hero_colors: red, cream, orange fire, small green porthole

cards.name: Blue Planet
cards.subject: A round blue planet with white swirls and one wide flat ring circling its middle at a tilt, the ring symmetrical, with a pink stripe on the planet.
cards.hero_colors: blue, white, small pink stripe

cards.name: Crystal
cards.subject: A cluster of three tall pointed blue crystals with flat hexagonal faces, the tallest in the middle, joined at one common base, with one small yellow crystal at the foot.
cards.hero_colors: blue, white highlights, small yellow crystal

cards.name: Orange Helmet
cards.subject: A round orange space helmet with a dark wide visor and a thick white ring collar, resting on grey metal floor plates.
cards.hero_colors: orange, dark grey visor, small white collar

cards.name: Blueprint
cards.subject: A flat rectangular blue sheet lying on a desk, with a white outline drawing of a rocket and a few white dots, and a small orange triangle ruler lying on one corner.
cards.hero_colors: blue, white, small orange ruler

cards.name: Jetpack
cards.subject: A silver jetpack with two upright round tanks side by side fixed to a flat back plate, two nozzles at the bottom of the tanks and two orange shoulder straps fixed to the plate, standing on the floor.
cards.hero_colors: silver, grey, small orange straps

cards.name: Radio Dish
cards.subject: A big white round dish tilted upward, on a short thick grey pedestal bolted to a concrete block, with a short arm holding a small red receiver at the dish center.
cards.hero_colors: white, grey, small red receiver
cards.surface_or_setting: a concrete block on a grassy field

cards.name: Airlock
cards.subject: A perfectly round grey hatch door set in a wall, with a round hand wheel in the center, six bolts around the frame and a yellow ring around the edge.
cards.hero_colors: grey, small yellow ring

cards.name: Cockpit Crew
cards.subject: The man in a silver jumpsuit sits at a spaceship console pressing a big green button, while the pig beside him in a silver jumpsuit proudly holds up a tiny toy rocket.
cards.hero_colors: silver, pink, brown, green button

cards.name: Saucer
cards.subject: A round silver flying saucer, symmetrical, with a smooth yellow glass dome on top and a flat disc rim with a band of red lights, flying in a clear sky.
cards.hero_colors: silver, yellow dome, small red lights

cards.name: Purple Planet
cards.subject: A round purple planet with pale lilac stripes and one wide flat ring circling its middle at a tilt, the ring symmetrical and yellow.
cards.hero_colors: purple, lilac, small yellow ring

cards.name: Space Shuttle
cards.subject: A white space shuttle with a pointed black nose, two swept wings, one upright tail fin with a red stripe and three round engine nozzles at the back, flying level in a clear sky.
cards.hero_colors: white, black nose, small red stripe

cards.name: Yellow Rocket
cards.subject: A tall yellow rocket with a rounded nose, one round green porthole and three orange fins at its base, standing upright on them.
cards.hero_colors: yellow, orange fins, small green porthole

cards.name: Lab Flask
cards.subject: A flat-bottomed conical glass flask with a narrow neck, a tan cork stopper and glowing blue liquid with three yellow bubbles, standing on a lab bench.
cards.hero_colors: blue liquid, clear glass, tan cork, small yellow bubbles

cards.name: Gold Rover
cards.subject: A golden yellow four-wheeled rover with black wheels, a flat boxy body and a small white round dish on a short mast fixed on top, standing on grey dust.
cards.hero_colors: golden yellow, black wheels, small white dish

cards.name: Moon Helmet
cards.subject: A round white space helmet with a wide curved gold visor and a thick ring collar with a red stripe, resting on grey dust.
cards.hero_colors: white, gold visor, small red stripe

cards.name: Porthole
cards.subject: A perfectly round porthole window with a thick grey metal frame and eight bolts around it, the glass showing a small orange ringed planet and white stars.
cards.hero_colors: grey, small orange planet

cards.name: Sliding Door
cards.subject: A closed grey metal sliding door set in a wall, with a small round window at the top and a small green light panel with an arrow icon fixed beside it.
cards.hero_colors: grey, small green light

cards.name: Zero Gravity
cards.subject: The sheep in a silver jumpsuit floats upside down inside a spaceship cabin, its fleece puffed up, while the pig in a silver jumpsuit holds its hoof and laughs.
cards.hero_colors: white, dark grey, pink, silver
